selected.focus: Chord root and bass note are different choices

selected.note: A complete four-minute community sequence was obtained; this is a 16-bar reduction for review. Its melody rises from C-sharp4/E4 material to C-sharp5/D5, and the selected string line returns at source beat 155.958. Piano, bass and basic drums are retained; guitar, extra strings, tambourine and other percussion are omitted. String notes play on piano, so this demonstrates note/register and entrance changes, not the original string timbre. Notation shows the pitched parts; detailed drums stay in playback and the beat grid. Exact verse/chorus boundary labels require recording or complete-score alignment.
